investigation_notes.summary: The stub's literal URL, carv.ai/affiliate, redirects to getcarv.com/affiliate, which 404s. getcarv.com's actual homepage is 'Carv - wearable ski coach. Ski better and have more fun.' - a physical hardware/ski-coaching product, NOT an AI/SaaS tool, and it has no affiliate program. At least two other unrelated companies also use the name 'Carv': (1) carv.com, described as 'The #1 AI recruitment platform,' which does have its own real Partner Program pages (carv.com/partner-program, /partner-program/brand-ambassador, /partner-program/referral-partner); and (2) 'CARV Protocol,' an unrelated blockchain gaming data layer project. Because it is unclear which (if any) of these three unrelated 'Carv' entities the original COSHUMA directory stub intended, no application was submitted anywhere, in order to avoid fabricating a match or applying on behalf of the wrong company.
